# hibira_waiting_room (Resource)

A waiting room of a Hibira app: visitors take a queue number on the hosted waiting page and are let in at `admit_per_minute`, each with a signed pass your edge or server checks. Live counters (admitted, waiting) are not part of the state. A room nobody changes or joins for 30 days is removed by Hibira; the next plan then creates it again.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "hibira_waiting_room" "presale" {
  app_id           = hibira_app.shop.id
  name             = "presale"
  admit_per_minute = 300
  state            = "paused"
  starts_at        = "2026-12-04T12:00:00+09:00"
  title            = "Winter tour presale"
  return_urls      = ["https://shop.example.com/drop"]

  # Pausing or closing the room from the portal during the sale? Keep
  # Terraform from switching it back on the next apply:
  # lifecycle { ignore_changes = [state, notice] }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `admit_per_minute` (Number) How many visitors are let in per minute.
- `app_id` (String) The app's ID.
- `name` (String) The room's name in URLs, passes and the `hibira_wr_<name>` cookie: 1 to 64 letters, digits, `-` or `_`. Changing it replaces the room.

### Optional

- `burst` (Number) How far the line may run ahead while the queue is empty. Default: ten seconds of admissions.
- `notice` (String) An announcement shown on the waiting page.
- `pass_ttl_seconds` (Number) How long a pass stays valid, 60 to 86400 seconds. Default 1800.
- `return_urls` (List of String) Where the waiting page may send admitted visitors (https, or http for localhost): the same host and a path prefix. The first is the default.
- `starts_at` (String) RFC 3339 time before which the line does not move (visitors can already take numbers). Empty or unset: no start time.
- `state` (String) `open` admits at the rate, `paused` keeps the queue but admits nobody, `closed` refuses new numbers (sold out). Default `open`.
- `title` (String) Shown on the waiting page.

### Read-Only

- `channel` (String) The cache channel the room's status is broadcast on (`cache-waitroom-<name>`), for your own waiting page.
- `id` (String) `<app_id>/<name>`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import hibira_waiting_room.presale app_123/presale
```
